When Tom develops a crush on schoolmate Melissa, Pappass feels abandoned and begins behaving erratically. (Comedy drama) - 2004

movieplex.us.title: The Shortcut
movieplex.us.description: Children grow up avoiding a path after kids go missing near a creepy old man's house. Now high school seniors, they decide to find out what the shovel-wielding weirdo is hiding. (Thriller, Horror) - 2009

movieplex.us.title: Dudes & Dragons
movieplex.us.description: An evil, jaded wizard makes it his business to rid the realm of love. Now, a brave warrior and his reluctant brother stand between the good people of the world and a fleet of fire-breathing dragons. (Fantasy, Comedy) - 2015

movieplex.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
movieplex.us.description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire. (Romantic comedy) - 2003

movies.us.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.us.description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. (Crime drama) - 1974

movies.us.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
movies.us.description: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). (Crime drama) - 1990

movies.us.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 1994

movies.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
movies.us.description: After serving time for a crime he did not commit, a vengeful barber (Johnny Depp) and his accomplice (Helena Bonham Carter) carve up unlucky customers and bake them in meat pies. - 2007

movies.us.title: Chicago
movies.us.description: A lawyer (Richard Gere) handles the cases of two murderous women (Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger) who are looking to gain celebrity from their public exposure. - 2002

movies.us.title: Dreamgirls
movies.us.description: After an ambitious manager (Jamie Foxx) gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost. - 2006

movies.us.title: Rocketman
movies.us.description: This musical biopic embarks on the journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became a figure of rock & roll. - 2019

movies.us.title: Better Man
movies.us.description: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams. - 2024

movies.us.title: Bob Marley: One Love
movies.us.description: Jamaican singer-songwriter Bob Marley overcomes adversity to create revolutionary music that changes the world. - 2024

movies.us.title: Almost Famous
movies.us.description: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour. - 2000

movies.us.title: Proof
movies.us.description: A depressed woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) copes with the death of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a brilliant but mentally ill mathematician. - 2005

movies.us.title: Good Will Hunting
movies.us.description: A therapist (Robin Williams), a mathematician and working-class roughs vie for the soul of a janitor (Matt Damon) with a genius IQ. - 1997

movies.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
movies.us.description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States. - 1999

movies.us.title: Saving Private Ryan
movies.us.description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat. - 1998

movies.us.title: Forrest Gump
movies.us.description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75. - 1994

movies.us.title: Up in the Air
movies.us.description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own. - 2009

movies.us.title: The Big Short
movies.us.description: In 2008, Wall Street guru Michael Burry realizes that a number of subprime home loans are in danger of defaulting. Burry bets against the housing market by throwing more than $1 billion of his investors' money into credit default swaps. His actions attract the attention of banker Jared Vennett (Ryan Gosling), hedge-fund specialist Mark Baum (Steve Carell) and other greedy opportunists. Together, these men make a fortune by taking full advantage of the impending economic collapse in America. (Comedy drama) - 2015

movies.us.title: Catch Me if You Can
movies.us.description: Frank Abagnale, Jr. works as a doctor, a lawyer and as a co-pilot for a major airline, all before his 18th birthday. A master of deception, he is a brilliant forger, whose skill gives him his first real claim to fame. At the age of 17, Frank Abagnale, Jr. becomes the most successful bank robber in the history of the U.S. FBI Agent Carl Hanratty makes it his prime mission to capture Frank and bring him to justice, but Frank is always one step ahead of him. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2002

movies.us.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.us.description: In 1987, Jordan Belfort takes an entry-level job at a Wall Street brokerage firm. By the early 1990s, while still in his 20s, Belfort founds his own firm, Stratton Oakmont. Together with his trusted lieutenant and a merry band of brokers, Belfort makes a huge fortune by defrauding wealthy investors out of millions. However, while Belfort and his cronies partake in a hedonistic brew of sex, drugs and thrills, the SEC and the FBI close in on his empire of excess. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2013

movies.us.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.us.description: In 1987, Jordan Belfort takes an entry-level job at a Wall Street brokerage firm. By the early 1990s, while still in his 20s, Belfort founds his own firm, Stratton Oakmont. movies.us.title: Titanic
movies.us.description: Two young lovers from different backgrounds meet and fall in love on the ill-fated maiden voyage of the unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic. (Historical drama, Romance) - 1997

movies.us.title: Shakespeare in Love
movies.us.description: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays. (Romantic comedy) - 1998

movies.us.title: Chocolat
movies.us.description: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. (Drama, Romance) - 2000

pop.us.title: The Outsiders
pop.us.description: A teen gang in rural Oklahoma, the Greasers are perpetually at odds with the Socials, a rival group. When Greasers Ponyboy (C. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

His career as a famous trapeze artist ended years ago after attempting a triple somersault gave him a permanent limp. Young acrobat Tino (Tony Curtis) tracks Mike down and asks him to teach him the dangerous stunt. Mike first refuses but is convinced by his ex-lover, Rosa (Katy Jurado). Mike and Tino have a shot at the big time, but the two men are driven apart by the scheming of Lola (Gina Lollobrigida), an Italian trampolinist. (Drama) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: Born Losers
screenpix.us.description: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy. (Crime drama) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: Thunder Road

Under pressure from both out-of-town gangster Kogan (Jacques Aubuchon), who wants a piece of the local action, and Treasury agent Barrett (Gene Barry), who wants to destroy the moonshine business, Luke fights for his fast-fading way of life. (Adventure, Drama, Action) - 1958

So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing. (Horror) - 1960

One day, he's visited by Adolphus Bedlo (Peter Lorre), who has been transformed into a raven after losing a duel to Dr. Scarabus (Boris Karloff), an evil wizard. After Craven transforms Bedlo back into a human, Bedlo claims to have seen Lenore's ghost at Scarabus' castle, prompting the two to head to Scarabus' castle to seek Craven's lost love. (Horror, Fantasy) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: I Bury the Living

When Robert accidentally puts a black pin in the just-purchased plots of a friend (Glenn Vernon) and his new wife, they die in a freak accident. Robert's uncle (Howard Smith) convinces him to make another switch, to see if it's coincidence or something more sinister. (Mystery) - 1958

(Thriller) - 1996

screenpixaction.us.description: After newly widowed Julie Kohler's mother stops her from committing suicide, she hatches a different plan to deal with her grief. In a small black book, she lists five men. One by one she visits the men with murderous intentions, assuming different identities to get close to them. Only one man remains elusive, having been captured by the cops before Julie could reach him -- but despite the obstacles, Julie intends to see her task through to the end. (Thriller) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: The Emerald Forest

Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe. (Adventure) - 1985

He comes out of a coma with amnesia, full of general knowledge but completely ignorant of his own family life. Slowly, he begins to put the pieces back together, but there are troubling memories that don't mesh with the stories he's being told, and he hires private detective Gus Klein (Bob Hoskins) to help unravel the mystery of his past. (Thriller) - 1991

He goes through the motions of his plush Arizona lifestyle but keeps having momentary visions of a violent past and a sinister figure he identifies as Thomas Payne (Brad Dourif). Billy reluctantly rides with the crooks, but a brotherly brawl breaks out and Matt is killed in the scuffle that he instigated, while his adolescent son, Ted (John Wilder), looks on. Unaware of his dad's dastardly side, Ted sics the law on Billy. (Western) - 1961

When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Brothers

Together, the two visit Chad's brother, Jubal (Neville Brand), only to learn that he is actually a cattle rustler. They convince him to go straight, antagonizing his partner, Shawnee Jack (Michael Ansara), who feels so betrayed that he comes after all three of them with guns blazing. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gunsight Ridge

Ryan begins to work with the area sheriff and falls for the lawman's pretty daughter, Molly Jones (Joan Weldon). With Clark hiding in plain sight as a piano player, the criminal manages to evade Ryan for a while, but eventually the two adversaries come face-to-face. (Western) - 1957

While the Sioux initially believe that divine intervention will save their tribe, Morgan convinces them that the only way to regain their land is to fight back. (Western) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians

Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull. (Comedy, Drama, Western) - 1976

showtimenext.us.title: Crawlspace

showtimenext.us.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe

showtimenext.us.title: Fight or Flight

showtimenext.us.title: Tommy Boy
showtimenext.us.description: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. (Comedy, Drama, Thriller) - 1999

Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: Imagine That

But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama) - 2009

showtimenext.us.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
showtimenext.us.description: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. (Thriller, Drama) - 2019

showtimenext.us.title: Beastly
showtimenext.us.description: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. (Fantasy, Romance, Drama) - 2011

showtimeshowcase.us.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor. (Drama) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Nine
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). (Musical, Romance) - 2009

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Just Go With It
showtimeshowcase.us.description: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. (Romantic comedy, Comedy) - 2011

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shakespeare in Love
showtimeshowcase.us.description: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays. (Romantic comedy) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Baby Driver

After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Top Gun

When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 1986

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies. - 2014

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines. - 1991

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shakespeare in Love
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Young William Shakespeare (Joseph Fiennes) falls for Viola (Gwyneth Paltrow), reawakening his creativity, but she is betrothed to Wessex. - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.description: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills. - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: You Can Count on Me

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Morning Glory

Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. (Comedy) - 2014

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: The Movie

The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: Number Two

Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2006

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass 3

(Comedy, Docudrama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2

After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Love and Monsters
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Comet

Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. (Romantic comedy) - 1998

At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life. (Romantic comedy, Comedy drama) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: Shall We Dance?

On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: Selena

Her father, Abraham (Edward James Olmos), realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete. (Biography, Drama) - 1997

showtimewomen.us.title: The Back-up Plan

Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017

Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell). (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 1999

But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

showtimewomen.us.title: A Very Brady Sequel

Her real husband, good-natured Mike (Gary Cole), is none too happy about their house guest. The Brady kids eventually catch wind of the deception, leading to an antic-filled excursion to Hawaii when the impostor steals a prized family possession. (Comedy) - 1996

showtimewomen.us.title: The First Wives Club

When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. (Comedy) - 1996

As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return. shoxbetwest.us.description: Cuba Gooding Jr. and Beyoncé Knowles star in this feel-good comedy about an advertising exec who must take over a struggling gospel choir in order to receive his much-needed inheritance. - 2003

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Dutchman
shoxbetwest.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Dark Tower
shoxbetwest.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Coach Carter
shoxbetwest.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Drama, Biography) - 2005

shoxbetwest.us.title: Hard Truths
shoxbetwest.us.description: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. (Comedy drama) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Equalizer 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. (Action, Thriller) - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Virtuosity
shoxbetwest.us.description: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree. (Action) - 1995

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kokomo City
shoxbetwest.us.description: Four Black transgender sex workers tell their life stories in intimate and candid interviews. (Documentary) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: 16 Shots
shoxbetwest.us.description: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald. (Documentary) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: NYC Point Gods
shoxbetwest.us.description: Point guards including Rafer Alston, Kenny Anderson, Mark Jackson, Stephon Marbury, Kenny Smith and Rod Strickland hone their craft and taste for showmanship on New York City's iconic playgrounds and in high school gyms in the 1980s and '90s. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2022-07-29

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hook
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: How to Train Your Dragon
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mr Fox plots one more raid on farmers Boggis, Bunce and Bean before he becomes a responsible father figure.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Super-Charlie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy attempts to solve an ongoing series of crimes with the help of his super-powered baby brother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hitpig!
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Smurfs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Chicken Run
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Bad Guys 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reformed criminals Mr. Wolf, Mr. Snake, Mr. Piranha, Mr. Shark and Ms. Tarantula find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes heist that's masterminded by a new team of delinquents they never saw coming -- the Bad Girls.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Minions
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Charlie the Wonderdog
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Babe
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Charlie Bucket comes from a poor family, and spends most of his time dreaming about the chocolate that he loves but usually can't afford. Things change when Willy Wonka, head of the very popular Wonka Chocolate empire, announces a contest in which five gold tickets have been hidden in chocolate bars. Charlie is one of the five kids who find a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Open Season

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - EnvyGram Wall
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger guard Swellview's newest attraction, the EnvyGram Wall; when Captain Man destroys the wall while trying to eliminate a small bird, Kid Danger and Captain Man have to figure out a way to replace it.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - I Know Your Secret
teennick.us.description: When Henry receives a series of mysterious notes from someone, he begins to worry that the sender may know his secret identity.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Green Fingers
teennick.us.description: After Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally affects Charlotte, Henry, his family, and even Ray, he quarantines them in Henry's house in order to find a cure.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Tale of Two Pipers
teennick.us.description: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future; when a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, the gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Love Muffin
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte discover things are not what they seem when Captain Man suddenly announces his plans to marry.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Fiñata Full of Death Bugs

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beat Goes On
teennick.us.description: Henry finds himself in danger when he realizes Dr. Minyak has transformed Charlotte into a super strong being set to capture Kid Danger and Captain Man.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Whole Bilsky Family
teennick.us.description: Henry's nerves are tested when Piper invites her new boyfriend and his family over for dinner.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Frittle Problem
teennick.us.description: When Henry's dad gets an offer for a new job in Bordertown, Henry and Ray go undercover to try and stop him from getting the job and prevent Henry from having to move.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Massage Chair
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man shows up with a cool new massage chair, Henry, Charlotte and Jasper compete in a series of physical and mental challenges to see who wins the chair.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Birthday
teennick.us.description: While trying to celebrate his birthday, Henry keeps getting interrupted by crimes going on in Swellview.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Balloons of Doom
teennick.us.description: When Dr. Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr. Minyak seeing them move.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double Date Danger
teennick.us.description: When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Trouble With Frittles
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger find themselves in the middle of a debate about Swellview's favorite snack.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Mom
teennick.us.description: When labor pains leave Captain Man helpless, Kid Danger and Piper step up to take on a couple of slick grease thieves.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Stuck in Two Holes
teennick.us.description: Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Room
teennick.us.description: Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Super Volcano
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray think the world is ending when a dormant super volcano under Swellview becomes active; Piper is convinced that she has gluten intolerance.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Escape Room
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man enter an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder, and become trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beginning of the End
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever; to make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Invisible Brad
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's friend, who was accidentally turned invisible, shows up for a visit, but quickly overstays his welcome.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Twin Henrys
teennick.us.description: Henry has a shape-shifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-05-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Game of Phones
teennick.us.description: When a young girl chains herself outside Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone; while on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toddler Invasion
teennick.us.description: When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-05

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Budget Cuts
teennick.us.description: When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high-speed railway in Swellview, the duo must figure out creative ways to save money. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-04-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Flabber Gassed
teennick.us.description: After acting too confident before a fight, Kid Danger and Captain Man are sprayed with Flabber Gas making them powerless to defeat a new villain in Swellview; Schwoz puts the heroes in Exo-Suits which Charlotte and Jasper control. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-20

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Rubber Duck
teennick.us.description: When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-13

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man-kini
teennick.us.description: When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double-O Danger
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man attempt to capture mob boss Rob Moss by infiltrating his daughter's Sweet 16 birthday party. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-06-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dream Busters
teennick.us.description: A villain's dream beam traps Henry in a dream state from which only Charlotte can rescue him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-21

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dodging Danger
teennick.us.description: After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-12-03

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Story Tank
teennick.us.description: Big steaks are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared; Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to virtually experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him in an attempt to prove Henry wrong. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-10-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Phony Valentine
teennick.us.description: When Henry's crush goes on a date with someone else, Schwoz provides an android to make her jealous; Ray has an unpleasant date with one of Henry's teachers. (Children, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2015-02-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Man of the House
teennick.us.description: After Henry's mother's purse is stolen, Captain Man decides he must move in with Henry's family in order to protect them. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Caved In
teennick.us.description: Henry, Charlotte and Ray are trapped inside when Jasper accidentally triggers the emergency lockdown mode for Junk-N-Stuff and the Man Cave. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-28

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Dinner With Bigfoot
teennick.us.description: When the gang befriends Bigfoot in the woods, Kid Danger and Captain Man try to help get rid of a pesky hunter that's been trying to capture him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-03-09

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Brawl in the Hall
teennick.us.description: When Charlotte is challenged to a fight at school, Captain Man and Kid Danger step in to try and help Charlotte defend herself. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-11-04

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Grand Theft Otto
teennick.us.description: When Piper's school parrot, Otto, starts to repeat that Henry is Kid Danger, Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte and Schwoz can find a way to fix things. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-02-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - License to Fly
teennick.us.description: Ray agrees to let Henry fly his helicopter, but Ray starts to act like a nervous parent; Charlotte, Jasper and Piper find a cotton candy machine. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-04-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Great Cactus Con
teennick.us.description: Jasper gets the chance to take his crush to Cactus Con, but when a mysterious villain gets involved in the convention, the entire gang is forced into action. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-24

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Flip This Flip; Haunted House Call
teennick.us.description: The Loud kids help Flip clean up his image to impress his middle school crush; when the Mortician's Club can't afford tickets to Casket Con, they decide to start a business to raise money. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-03-18

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Grub Snub; She's All Bat
teennick.us.description: When Leni and her friends start hanging out at Gus', Lincoln and the gang start a turf war for control; Lucy gets jealous of Lola's newfound attention after she joins the Mortician's Club. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-05-28

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House of Lies; Game Boys
teennick.us.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs; Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2018-09-17

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Funny Business; Snow Bored
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-11-08

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Toads and Tiaras; Two Boys and a Baby
teennick.us.description: When Lola gets sick and is unable to compete in a pageant, Lincoln coaches Lana to take her place; thinking it will be easy, Lincoln and Clyde decide to take on the task of baby-sitting Lily. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-07-21

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Store Wars With the Casagrandes; Lucha Fever With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-06-20

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Bummer Camp; Sleepstakes
teennick.us.description: When Gramps struggles to run Camp Mastodon, the kids come to his rescue; the Loud kids help Lana get over her fear of sleepovers. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-06-10

teennick.us.description: Lincoln has his hands full when all 10 of his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day; Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Lincoln and Bobby's little sister, Ronnie Anne. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-08-04

teennick.us.description: Lincoln must beat each of his sisters to the couch in order to watch the finale of his favorite show; Lincoln leaves a scathing voicemail on Lori's phone, and quickly realizes that he must erase it before she hears it. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-02

teennick.us.description: Lincoln must care for the class tarantula; Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Driving Miss Hazy; No Guts, No Glori
teennick.us.description: Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-10

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Back to School
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max return to their elementary school to complete a hero assessment exam and discover that the instructor is a former classmate that Max tormented. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-08-13

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Max's Minions
teennick.us.description: Max takes on a group of freshmen to be his minions; Max becomes the victim of a humiliating prank. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2014-09-27

themoviechannel.us.title: Patriot Games
themoviechannel.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Red Eye
themoviechannel.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: Patriot Games
themoviechannel.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: The Mechanic
themoviechannel.us.description: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: The November Man
themoviechannel.us.description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey). - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: After learning that his memory has been erased, a technical wizard (Ben Affleck) goes on the run to piece together clues from his past. - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Super
themoviechannel.us.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Machete Kills
themoviechannel.us.description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world. - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: The Core
themoviechannel.us.description: In order to save mankind, scientists and astronauts must set off a nuclear device at the center of the Earth. - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Flight of the Intruder
themoviechannel.us.description: Two Navy pilots (Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson) hatch a rogue mission to bomb Hanoi with a special low-altitude plane. - 1991

themoviechannel.us.title: Rules of Engagement
themoviechannel.us.description: A decorated career Marine (Samuel L. Jackson), about to stand trial for a botched rescue mission, asks an old friend (Tommy Lee Jones) to defend him. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Bleed for This
themoviechannel.us.description: With help from trainer Kevin Rooney, champion boxer Vinny Pazienza tries to make a comeback after breaking his neck in a car accident. - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
themoviechannel.us.description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States. - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen). - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child. - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school. - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Men in White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Leonard Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) is looking for a new assistant, and his two interns -- girl-crazy Dr. Randall "Red" Adams (Van Johnson) and studious Dr. Lee Wong How (Keye Luke) -- both want the job. To decide who gets the position, Gillespie assigns each a test case to solve. For both doctors, the seemingly straightforward assignments turn out to be more complex than they first realized, requiring examinations of the patients' home lives that go beyond mere medicine. (Drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Tom Thumb
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In a mythical land, woodcutter Jonathan (Bernard Miles) agrees not to chop down the oldest tree in the forest in return for three wishes granted by the Forest Queen. After he wastes two wishes bickering with his wife, the third brings them Tom (Russ Tamblyn), a thumb-sized child. The couple dote upon him, but are unable to protect him when, on his way to the village, the innocent Tom falls in with villainous Ivan (Terry-Thomas) and Tony (Peter Sellers). (Children, Fantasy) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Roughshod
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rancher Clay (Robert Sterling) and his brother, Steve (Claude Jarman Jr.), head out across the Sonora mountain pass, followed by Lednov (John Ireland), an ex-con seeking revenge on Clay for putting him behind bars. Clay and Steve unexpectedly cross paths with a group of dance hall girls -- including Mary (Gloria Grahame), Marcia (Martha Hyer) and Helen (Myrna Dell) -- whose stagecoach has broken down, and help them get to the nearest ranch, where Lednov unfortunately catches up to Clay. (Western) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The V.I.P.s
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Inclement weather has delayed a flight from London's Heathrow Airport to New York City. A cross-section of elite passengers waits to board the plane as they experience various life crises. Among them: Frances (Elizabeth Taylor), a woman fleeing a loveless marriage to her millionaire husband, Paul (Richard Burton) ; a duchess (Margaret Rutherford) who has fallen on hard times; and Gloria (Elsa Martinelli), an aspiring actress accompanied by her money-grubbing producer, Max (Orson Welles). (Comedy drama) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Last of Sheila

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Born Free
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At a national park in Kenya, English game warden George Adamson (Bill Travers) and his wife, Joy (Virginia McKenna), care for three orphaned lion cubs. After the two larger lions are shipped off to a zoo in the Netherlands, the smallest of the three, Elsa, stays with the couple. When Elsa is blamed for causing an elephant stampede in the nearby village, head warden John Kendall (Geoffrey Keen) demands the young lion either be trained to survive in the wilds of the Serengeti or be sent to a zoo. (Docudrama) - 1966

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tragedy seems to follow Pearl Chavez everywhere she goes. After a domestic dispute results in the death of both of her parents, Pearl moves in with her aunt, Laura Belle, on an expansive farm. When Pearl notices Laura Belle's son, the fiery Lewt, life on the ranch erupts into chaos. The two have a brief courtship, but Lewt abruptly ends the relationship. When Pearl tries to move on, Lewt's jealousy leads to a climactic gun battle between the former lovers. (Western) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wizard of Oz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young Dorothy (Dorothy Dwan), a farm girl from Kansas, discovers that she's actually Princess Dorothea, the royal heir to a faraway kingdom called Oz. Suddenly, a powerful tornado whisks Dorothy, her uncle Henry (Frank Alexander) and three farmhands to the magical kingdom. There Dorothy is hailed as the queen of the land by all except authoritarian Prime Minister Kruel (Joseph Swickard), who casts a curse on Dorothy in an attempt to maintain his dictatorial reign. (Fantasy) - 1925

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stolen Kisses
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The third in a series of films featuring François Truffaut's alter-ego, Antoine Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), the story resumes with Antoine being discharged from military service. His sweetheart Christine's (Claude Jade) father lands Antoine a job as a security guard, which he promptly loses. Stumbling into a position assisting a private detective, Antoine falls for his employers' seductive wife, Fabienne (Delphine Seyrig), and finds that he must choose between the older woman and Christine. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Soft Skin

What was intended to be a one-night stand becomes a tumultuous extramarital affair once he gets back to Paris and his wife (Nelly Benedetti) and kids. Pierre tries to keep the affair secret, but, when his wife suspects him, she snaps. (Romance) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Princess O'Rourke

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - Breakthrough Boats
history.ca.description: How do you master a planet covered by 70% water? Build history-changing machines to conquer it; Dolph Lundgren dives into the stealthy German U-boats that nearly won WWII, the ancient canoes that crossed the Pacific, James Cameron's groundbreaking Deepsea Challenger, and the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier that faced down nuclear war; welcome to Water World. (Documentary) - 2026-06-29

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - World's Fastest
history.ca.description: Speed is more than a number, it's human ambition in high octane; Dolph Lundgren hits overdrive with the record-breakers, the Thrust SSC jet car blasting past Mach 1, Concorde's legendary supersonic jet that halved travel times and NASA's Parker Solar Probe, the fastest man-made object in history; fasten your seatbelt for an adrenaline-pumping journey through machines built by speed-obsessed visionaries. (Documentary) - 2026-07-06

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - Rocket Science
history.ca.description: Sometimes it really is rocket science with a twist; blast through history with Dolph Lundgren as he reveals the rockets that transformed warfare, exploration and human potential, from the ancient Korean Hwacha artillery that changed battlefields forever, to the Saturn V moon rocket that captured humanity's imagination, to Martin-Baker's rocket-powered ejection seat that saved over 7,000 lives; fasten your seatbelts for a blast of history like you've never seen. (Documentary) - 2026-07-13

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - Monster Machines
history.ca.description: If size counts, these machines rewrite all the rules; Dolph Lundgren gets up close inside legendary giants: the Antonov An-225 cargo jet history's largest aircraft; the 200-ton WWII Maus tank designed by Porsche for Hitler, the largest ever made; and Bigfoot, the original monster truck that created a global phenomenon; when small isn't enough, Dolph goes massive with these supersized beasts. (Documentary) - 2026-06-15

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - Devices of Deception
history.ca.description: Dolph Lundgren pulls the curtain back on the shadowy devices that won secret wars, the CIA's pigeon-mounted spy cameras, bone-conduction radios hidden inside tobacco pipes, the silent heart attack gun and the secret Enigma code that changed WWII. (Documentary) - 2026-06-22

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - Change Agents

(Documentary) - 2026-07-20

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: The Way, Way Back
moremax.us.description: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one. (Comedy drama) - 2013

moremax.us.title: The Flash
moremax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
moremax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Donal's Feasts, Fasts And Festivals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Donal joins a Muslim family who are fasting during Ramadan, explores the traditions of the Romanian Orthodox Community as he prepares a traditional Easter meal and joins in the atmosphere of Diwali.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Under The Pump Seven weeks after opening, the new Sydney Fish Market faces its first Good Friday as fuel costs, wild weather and an auction failure threaten Easter supplies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Hong Kong One hundred years ago, there was a Dai Pai Dong, or street food stall, on every Hong Kong street corner, serving up super fast, mouthwatering, and affordable meals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Coromandel Tane comes from the sea with a bag of kai moana. He pulls out a bottle of kombucha and offers it to Sachie, telling her it is made from seaweed. Sachie and Tane collect seaweed.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Thailand And Malaysia Rick takes a train to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong, the culinary icon of Thailand. Later he meets up with one of his cooking heroes, David Thompson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Cuba's Savory Secrets In search of Cuba's most authentic and delicious ingredients, Gordon embraces local ingenuity as he fishes and forages his way across the island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Central Ainsley is in central Malta where he starts his day exploring the beautiful ancient city of Mdina. After a tour of the city, Ainsley stops by a restaurant with an impressive history and a great view.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Lazy Breakfasts Marcus wants to discover unique Mallorcan breakfasts and he begins his search at Mistral, the first cafe on the island to roast their own coffee.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Black Eyed Pea Biryani Chef Deborah VanTrece brings together Southern and Indian flavours with her black-eyed pea biryani.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Town
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: When a professional thief falls for a past victim, he begins to question his own lifestyle. Forced to do one last heist before he calls it quits, he has to plan the crime while the FBI close in.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Secret World of Arrietty
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young boy comes across a tiny family living below the floorboards of his mother's childhood home, who survive by borrowing items from the humans living in the house.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Brief Encounter
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Housewife Laura Jesson meets Dr Alec Harvey at a railway station café and there is a spark. While both are married, they are tempted to adultery before they realise their marriages are more important than the fleeting happiness they may find together.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Tea With Mussolini
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young Italian boy is taken in by an Englishwoman and her group of eccentric friends in the middle of World War II.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Godzilla Minus One
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Japan has barely recovered from World War II when a gigantic peril emerges off the coast of Tokyo. Koichi, a deserter traumatised by his first confrontation with Godzilla, sees this as an opportunity to redeem his conduct during the war.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Girls Will Be Girls
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In a strict boarding school nestled in the Himalayas, teenager Mira discovers desire and romance. However, Mira's mother, who never got to come of age herself, disrupts her rebellious sexual awakening.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Crow's Egg
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Two boys from the Chennai slums constantly make demands on their family who do what they can to provide. A television inspires a shared dream between them, and they start developing schemes to make enough money to buy a pizza.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Lunchbox
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: After her husband's homemade lunch is mistakenly delivered to someone else, a lonely housewife strikes up a friendship via letters with the recipient.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Bend It Like Beckham
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: An Asian teenager cannot tell her traditionally-minded parents that she has joined a women's football team.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Hindi Vindi
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A Sydney teenager bridges cultural gaps through music when he creatively fuses Australian hip-hop with traditional Hindi songs to connect with his beloved grandmother.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Brassed Off
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The threat of a coal mine closure in a small Yorkshire village strikes a sour note with the miners' brass band, who are preparing for a national competition.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Operation Napoleon
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A lawyer is sucked into an international conspiracy after being accused of a murder she didn't commit. Her only chance of survival lies in uncovering the secret of an old German WWII aeroplane discovered on Iceland's largest glacier.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: When Will It Be Again Like It Never Was Before
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Joachim's family home is on the grounds of a psychiatric hospital, where his father is the director. Joachim's unconventional upbringing sees him plagued by fits of anger and sadness.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Crow's Egg
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Two boys from the Chennai slums constantly make demands on their family who do what they can to provide. A television inspires a shared dream between them, and they start developing schemes to make enough money to buy a pizza.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Becoming Jane
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A youthful Jane Austen meets dashing but poor lawyer Tom Lefroy. The love affair that follows inspires her greatest works.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Explorers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Three boys combine their talents and construct a homemade spaceship to launch themselves into another galaxy, where they meet some unusual aliens.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Close
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The 13-year-old boys Léo and Rémi have a close friendship at school and in the flower fields where they and their parents pick the harvest for home. When schoolmates shoot a wedge into the relationship, the consequences are fatal.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Brassed Off
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The threat of a coal mine closure in a small Yorkshire village strikes a sour note with the miners' brass band, who are preparing for a national competition.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Housewife Laura Jesson meets Dr Alec Harvey at a railway station café and there is a spark. While both are married, they are tempted to adultery before they realise their marriages are more important than the fleeting happiness they may find together.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Tea With Mussolini
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young Italian boy is taken in by an Englishwoman and her group of eccentric friends in the middle of World War II.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Above Us the Waves
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Based on an actual incident in WWII, this tale follows the efforts of three naval officers to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz, which holds a seemingly impregnable position in a Norwegian fjord.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Arctic Convoy
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1941, a convoy carrying vital military supplies to Allied Forces crosses treacherous, enemy-infested waters. The 35 civilian merchant ships brave brutal Arctic seas, fighting for their lives against German air and naval attacks.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Last Samurai
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In the 1870s, a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Knight of Cups
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Rick is a slave to the Hollywood system. He is addicted to success but simultaneously despairs at the emptiness of his life. A screenwriter living in LA, he tries to make sense of the strange events occurring around him.

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E5 Four to Doomsday: Part 1 The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans via their manopticon devices. Intrigued, they begin dividing the Doctor’s friends, and disguising themselves as humans.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E6 Four to Doomsday: Part 2 As the Doctor meets the representatives of humanity aboard the Urbankan ship, a Grecian philosopher reveals a bizarre secret about Monarch and his methods.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E7 Four to Doomsday: Part 3 Panicking, Tegan accidentally pilots the TARDIS into space, while Lin Fitu betrays the Doctor and Bigon to Monarch, who demands they be beheaded as punishment.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E8 Four to Doomsday: Part 4 The Doctor takes a dangerous spacewalk to rescue Tegan, while Nyssa ansd Bigon keep the Urbankans distracted and Adric decides exactly whose side he is on.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E9 Kinda: Part 1 While Nyssa rests, Adric and the Doctor discover a military expedition on Deva Loka. Tegan falls asleep in the forest watched by the Kinda, but they cannot stop her dreams.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E10 Kinda: Part 2 Sanders meets Panna and Karuna, who leave a lasting impression on him, while the Dukkha does the same on Tegan. When Hindle’s breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E11 Kinda: Part 3 Aris now carries the mark of the Mara and has gained voice, so Panna shows the Doctor and Todd exactly what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E12 Kinda: Part 4 As the Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension, the Kinda must do everything they can to contain it. Hindle’s need to destroy everything and everyone is unstoppable.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E13 The Visitation: Part 1 The TARDIS lands in 17th century England which is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure from behind a holographic wall. The locals seem to be under a strange mesmeric spell.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E14 The Visitation: Part 2 A Terileptil is living in Sir John's basement and is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats. It decides to arrange for the Doctor and Richard Mace to be beheaded.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E15 The Visitation: Part 3 Nyssa and Adric and pursued by the Android, and they head to the safety of the TARDIS, while a mesmerised Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E16 The Visitation: Part 4 Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding. Forced to find a way to stop them, their soliton gas generator explodes, setting London ablaze.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E17 Black Orchid: Part 1 A murder is committed in Cranleigh Hall. The Cranleighs ask the Doctor to play cricket and then join them for a masked ball, enabling the killer to hide in plain sight.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E18 Black Orchid: Part 2 The Doctor stands accused, despite Lady Cranleigh knowing he is innocent. What is the secret she is protecting that allows her to let an honest man go to jail.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E19 Earthshock: Part 1 Deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
