BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E21 Earthshock: Part 3 The Cybermen are released from their silos and are on the march.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E1 The Leisure Hive: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana visit the Leisure Hive on Argolis. The Argolin, survivors of a war, run the Hive as a tourist attraction but its future is jeopardised by a series of deaths.

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E24 Time-Flight: Part 2 After an encounter with the Plasmatons, Nyssa is possessed by strange aliens while the Doctor, joined by Professor Hayter investigates Kalid’s inner sanctum.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E25 Time-Flight: Part 3 From within their sarcophagus, the gestalt Xeraphin are communicating through Nyssa, but their psychic energy is so powerful, it may destroy her body completely.

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E26 Time-Flight: Part 4 The Master’s TARDIS is repaired and the Doctor must follow him back to 20th century Heathrow, once he has rescued all the passengers and crew from both Concordes.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E2 Arc of Infinity: Part 2 Commander Maxil doesn’t believe the Doctor is innocent and reckons the easiest way to stop the evil being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E3 Arc of Infinity: Part 3 President Borusa thinks the creature has been defeated but within the Matrix, the Doctor unmasks Omega and realises the threat to the matter universe is far from over.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E4 Arc of Infinity: Part 4 Omega has been reborn in Amsterdam in the Doctor's form, but the transference hasn’t worked. The Doctor pursues him through the city, aware Omega is now a walking anti-matter bomb.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E23 The Manchurian Dinner Date Eddie is excited for his mum to meet his girlfriend, but worries Jessica won't approve because Alison is not Taiwanese. Louis helps Emery prepare his graduation speech, and Grandma attempts to make a new suit for Evan.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E8 Corby QI has questions relating to the town of Corby. Joining Stephen Fry are panellists Alan Davies, Bill Bailey, Phill Jupitus and David Mitchell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E13 Mine And Ours The Jedi join a friend in a wilderness adventure.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E27 Bat Flap Fever Mavis is horrified by her Dad's new Dracula-endorsed, Mavis-named, Mavy-Wavy fashion wings. So she tosses them out the window where they just happen to be found by humans. What's the worst that can happen?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E28 Thumb and Thumber Hank has been researching where all of his body parts have come from and he gets some surprising news -- his thumb is from the great patriarch of the Dracula dynasty. Hank's thumb is royalty!

ABCMESydney.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E13 The Case Of The Science Sabotage When Annie's science fair experiment is stolen, the Inbestigators must track it down before the judging commences.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 Power Up Puff Buttercup and Bubbles \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Business Time When Finn and take in a group of business men who washed up on shore, they become fatter and lazier when the businessmen start doing everything for them, even being heroes. But the businessmen take it too far.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 Charlie's Big Foot The Bears sneak Charlie into a hospital for medical assistance.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E32 Obinray The Titans speak Pig Latin to stop Robin from eavesdropping.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E20 Qilin Because of one of Marinette's careless mistakes, one of her closest relatives is akumatized into Qilin, a fearsome supervillain. Will Ladybug dare to fight her?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Moominvalley
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E4 Little My Moves Out When Moomintroll gets his wish to be free of the troublesome Little My, he soon comes to regret it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mechamato
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Social Media Influenza When a bad robot named Influenzo control the minds of people all over Kota Hilir, Amato and friends need to find a way to save them before things get worse.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Deep
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 Tartaruga The Nektons explore a floating island and find the final piece of the Ephemychron in a cave. When Ant assembles it, it works! Perhaps now they can find Lemuria! But why is this island moving? What is its terrible secret?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E2 There Wolf The gang rushes Scooby to an animal hospital when he suddenly falls ill. But things go from bad to worse when they discover the Gothic, old hospital is also home to a rampaging werewolf!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E13 Pepper and The Fog Pepper tries to make his way to Susie's house through the fog.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Balloon Quest The heroes think that their latest quest - delivering thirty birthday balloons to Mr. Friendlyface's cousin - will be easy.but soon realise that it's a much trickier task than expected.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E35 The Ritual Jim refuses to perform the 'ritual sardine sacrifice' invented by his father. But faced with the panic of the crew, who fear that misfortune will befall them, Jim has to invent a new tradition.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E12 The Upgrade Gumball and Darwin see an advert for the latest, cutting-edge Bobert operating system and excitedly talk Bobert into downloading it. At first it seems like a massive improvement, but the many flaws become glaring.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Badjelly
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Who's Game? The path to Mudwiggle's ferry leads the gang through the lair of The Unfungi, a grumpy old hermit who lives in a cave full of puzzles and traps.

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E2 First Time Playing Little Kitty Big City Harry joins Sueann for their very first time playing Little Kitty, Big City! There's so much to do like collect shiny things, smash jars of jam, and. recycle? Will it get a purr-fect 10 or are they kitten themselves?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E14 Derision What if the answer to Marinette's relationship problems lay in her own past? Back when she wasn't the Marinette we know today.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Next Step: Cheer ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E9 Superstitions Sensing something off, Ruby spies on Melody. Levi faces his first test as cheer captain. Desperate for an advantage over Olive, Layla turns to Angel for help.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Storks
ABCMESydney.au.description: Storks deliver babies... or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for global internet giant Cornerstore.com. Junior, the company's top delivery stork, accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E4 Coach And Plane George is amazed by a couple's plan to turn a coach into a mobile home, complete with a garage! A pilot creates a den from a small plane and George's observatory build takes him to one of the world's largest telescopes.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E4 Schooling When Charlie's school gets a bad Ofsted rating, Lee and Lucy start looking around for alternative schools. Geoffrey and Wendy offer to pay to send Charlie to private school, which presents Lee and Lucy with a moral dilemma.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Midsomer Murders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S19 E1 The Village That Rose From The Dead The ghost village of Little Auburn has been abandoned since the war. When a young man is found murdered during its grand reopening, DCI Barnaby must unravel a sinister web of lies to catch the killer.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E11 Night Shift A night that begins slowly soon ignites: Mark risks his career to save a life. Benton discovers Carter's secret. Charlie returns to the ER after being raped and beaten, and the ER suffers the shocking loss of one of its own.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont-Spelling Bee
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 The series premiere kicks off with four guest comedians Urzila Carlson, Nazeem Hussain, Danielle Walker and Tom Gleeson where they take on a spelling challenge on Australian currency, and try to make their hometown proud.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Albania Stephen Fry hosts the world's most impossible quiz show. Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Clive Anderson, Linda Smith and Sean Lock.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E11 More Unseen Bits More unseen clips from this series of Would I Lie To You? Joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Greg Davies, Sharon Osborne, Henning Wehn, Simon Day, Dr Ranj Singh, Asim Chaudhry, and Clare Balding.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E22 Curving Bullets Adam and Jamie enlist the Blue Angels to find out if a sonic shock wave can shatter glass; Tory, Grant and Kari try to bend bullets around obstacles.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Altrincham Phil Spencer advises on how to spruce up and sell a three-bedroom detached cottage on the outskirts of Manchester that has been on the market for a staggering four years with no offers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E5 Fire Engine, Shepherd's Hut And Telescope A couple turn an old fire engine into a bar, to raise money for charity. Max builds a shepherds Hut from scratch, including the nuts and bolts! George visits an extraordinary home in Chile and Will builds a telescope.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E4 Caleb Harper, Dami Im, Nikki Britton & Andrew Maxwell We look at Eurovision history. Australia has tonight's guest, Dami Im. Ireland has Dustin the Turkey. Plus, Spacey Jane's Caleb Harper, comedians Nikki Britton and Andrew Maxwell. Julia Jacklin closes the show.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S15 E6 Night David Mitchell, Noel Fielding and Holly Walsh join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig to contemplate the theme of 'night'.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E7 Episode 7 Rob Brydon is back as host with team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests John Cooper Clarke, Lucia Keskin, Kadiff Kirwan, and Sara Pascoe.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Keith and Kate have returned to the Scottish seaside town of Dunoon, where her dad grew up and she holidayed annually. But restoring the grand Victorian house they bought comes with costly surprises.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Recipe of the Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 It's time to fire up the BBQ as the remaining home cooks head outside to create their best BBQ recipes, as judged by frontline volunteers of the SES.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E12 Post Mortem Carter rebukes Benton for his seeming lack of concern over Gant's death. Jeanie hits it off with a handsome infectious disease expert. Carol takes the blame for a patient's death, and Ross considers being Charlie's guardian.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Offsiders
ABCMESydney.au.description: E40 Abbey Gelmi and the panel discuss the week in sport including the Rugby League World Cup Semi Finals, Week 1 of the AFLW Finals, WBBL, team selections ahead of the Australia v England One Day Series and Wallabies Spring Tour.

ABCMESydney.au.description: E312 Discover the wildest new music videos on rage. Essential grooves and boundary-pushing visuals from Australia and beyond.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Altrincham Phil Spencer advises on how to spruce up and sell a three-bedroom detached cottage on the outskirts of Manchester that has been on the market for a staggering four years with no offers.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Noel It's been five years since we last saw the Worsleys, with Paul and Ally on the verge of splitting and Jim and Jackie in turmoil. Things are no less dramatic now as Luke and girlfriend Maya drop a bombshell at Christmas dinner.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 No Alternative The reality of Luke's announcement hits, and Paul and Ally worry about the decision he and Maya have made. As a New Year starts, the Worsley family gather together with Maya's family, united in their love and worry.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E3 No Age Ally is appalled that she’s about to turn 50 and bans the family from ever mentioning that number. Paul tries to help Luke, who is overwhelmed by learning to drive and becoming a dad, while Ava meets a charismatic girl called Holly.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 A Tale of Two Ice Bears The Bears accidentally clone Ice Bear and Ice Bear has a hard time adjusting.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E39 What's Opera, Titans? Robin surprises the Titans with a trip to the opera, but they soon fall asleep, and all dream about starring in their own operas.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E40 Sideline Dad When the Girls start playing soccer, the Professor goes overboard.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E15 Zombizou The sweet Miss Bustier gets akumatized into Zombizou. Armed with an evil black lipstick, she wants to spread love in the city... by force. Ladybug and Cat Noir can't get zombizoufied if they want to save Paris!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E6 The Nurse Celeste lies that she started the fire to be sent home. Sally confronts Matron about her eyesight while Miss Grayling tells Celeste about her Mother.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Pilot Hannah and Leo arrive at OME. Chan-Mi, who doesn't see the point in learning English, connects with Hannah when they sing together. Impressed with her vocal talents, Ken asks Hannah if she's ever considered being a trainee.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 The Germblock Melanie is very upset when Tamara 'germblocks' Melanie, the rule that forces someone to be isolated if they have done something disgusting. Tamara has accused Melanie of not washing her hands after going to the toilet.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E26 Turning Over A Nuzleaf When our heroes get separated from their Pokemon in a deep, dark cave, both groups find themselves in trouble!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 Last Hope: Part 2 With time of the essence, the Terrans unite to bring down Mandroid's superweapon and save their family.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E13 Princess Cookie Finn and Jake are called on to solve a Candy Kingdom hostage crisis when a rogue cookie takes over.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E38 TV Knight 2 Batman and Commissioner Gordon have a slumber party to watch TV.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E41 Cool Uncles The Titans take a trip to Wackadoodles, but Trigon makes Raven babysit her little brothers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E28 The Uncle Gumball and Darwin are desperate to meet Ocho's famous uncle.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 A Barb is Born On the third day of the world, Barb tries to save the ferns from being eaten by the spotted bears. But the bears are only getting hungrier and hungrier - will Barb be able to stop the ferns from going extinct?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Foam Party Jim finds out that the sardines have parties, and it looks like he is somehow not on the list. He tries to not take it personally, but it's hard to be both a captain and a friend.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 Having The Timeout Of Our Lives Owen forms a special bond with Duncan after having loads of fun with him during their timeouts.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Adventures of a Normal Man Pt. 1 Secret alien Clark Kent and his best friend Jimmy Olsen start their internship at The Daily Planet and meet fellow intern Lois Lane - who ropes them into investigating stolen military robots threatening Metropolis!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Snakebit Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe - The Fangpyres - to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 School Learn to spell and write the word School. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 The Breakfast Bears The Three Bears can't make their breakfast in the right order because they all want to go first! Go, Stop and The Breakfast Crew help them figure things out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 Pick a Partner The Colourblocks enjoy a dance, but which colours make the best partners. Learn about similar and complimentary colours with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E17 Back in the Box! The Numberblocks have fun counting as they tidy up after games, but One finds it hard to keep track of everything. The friends use tally marks to fix their problem!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 Quest for Mr. Furmore Mr. More comes to the Super Readers for help solving the mystery of his missing cat!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 Umbrella Maddie heads to an umbrella factory to see how umbrellas are made using waterproof material.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E17 Bird Paradise Millie, Maeve and Pia love birds. But what about the humble Ibis, or Bin Chicken? Millie loves them! They create a sanctuary for Ibises and other native birds and watch them enjoy their brand new Bird Paradise.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Heart Dr Chris and Dr Xand get to grips with the heart and show how to build a pumping heart model in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Science Max: Experiments at Large
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E12 Balance How can you balance a potato on a stick and can Phil balance on a tightrope using the same science? What's better for balance, staying put or using something that spins? Phil designs a gyroscopic stabilization backpack.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Physics House
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Why Does My Toast Land Buttered Side Down? Why is it that toast usually seems to land buttered-side down? Is it the weight of the butter? Or are there other forces at work? Join Yanick in the Physics House and get to the physics behind your ruined breakfast.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Bread It's an early rise for Dr Karl as he starts the day at the Goodman Fielder bakery in Burleigh Heads where they bake 100,000 loaves of bread every day.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Spooks returns with MI5's crack team of spies taking on a terrorist group after a bomb explosion in London.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 Film Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Alan Davies, John Sessions, Emma Thompson and David Mitchell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E4 Episode 4 Jack Carroll, Bridget Christie, Gabby Logan, and Big Zuu join host Rob Brydon and team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell to sort out the fact from the fiction.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E23 Thermite Vs. Ice Adam and Jamie put a classic YouTube myth to the test in 'Thermite v. Ice'. The result is one of the most dangerous outcomes they've ever had.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Dorking Phil's latest secret mission takes him to Dorking, where he finds a period property that's charming on the outside and a little bit alarming on the inside.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E26 Episode 26 Yolanda Brown, Rev Kate Bottley, Joel Dommett and John Thomson test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. The crews live by the "work hard, play harder" motto that gives them access to exotic perks few people get to experience. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2013-07-01

oxygenwest.us.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
oxygenwest.us.description: As Hooters reached its peak in the 2000s, several women who worked at Hooters were targeted by predators and murdered in cold blood; a look at how women who worked at the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E01 Beloved Veteran Kelly and the team help the Lake Station Police department look into the 2007 slaying of a kind-hearted WWII veteran killed with a sledgehammer; tracing the purchases on his stolen credit card may be the key to solving the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E02 Silenced The team helps the Abilene Police Department investigate the heartbreaking double homicide of a devoted mother and her young daughter strangled in their home; DNA evidence left at the scene might help identify their killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E03 Killer at the Door Kelly and Steve join the Kankakee Police Department to help a woman who just missed seeing her mother's killer at their front door when she was 11 years old; decades later, efforts are made to recall any clues to help crack the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E04 Enemy Next Door Kelly and Steve extend their stay in Illinois to help the Kankakee Police Department look into another mysterious case -- the unsolved homicide of a mother-to-be and her unborn child.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E05 Some Kind of Monster Kelly, Tonya and the Alcoa Police Department investigate the 1990 rape and murder of a beloved 80-year-old grandmother and consider if the perpetrator may have been a sadistic random intruder or a member of her own family.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E06 The Reporter Beautiful, ambitious reporter Jennifer Servo is shockingly murdered in 2002; Kelly and Steve are determined to help the Abilene Police Department catch her killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E01 The Texas Seven After seven inmates escape a Texas prison, their crime spree results in the murder of a police officer; a nationwide manhunt leads to six capital murder trials, as one prosecutor must prove how each of the six can be responsible for one murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E02 Deadly Deception The murder of Jamie Faith appears to be a random street shooting until investigators uncover fake identities, thousands of messages and murderous manipulation; prosecutors must prove how a long-distance relationship led to murder in Dallas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Tourniquet Killer When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E04 Triangle of Guilt A young woman vanishes after a night out in Dallas, leading investigators to the home of an aspiring rapper in a twisted love triangle; following an international manhunt, prosecutors must prove who killed her with no weapon or cause of death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E05 High-Heel Homicide A Houston professor is found bludgeoned to death in his high-rise condo. His ex-girlfriend claims she fought for her life with the only weapon within reach: her high-heel shoe. Prosecutors must prove where self-defense ends and murder begins.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: Sneak Peek: A Season of Suspicion For some, the holidays bring loved ones together. For others, they bring a killer closer to home. Preview the all-new season of Homicide For the Holidays.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E37 Good & Evil After a young woman's body is discovered at a trash facility, a detective promises justice and comes face-to-face with a serial killer; Keith Morrison revisits the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E38 The House A woman finds her father, a former FBI agent, murdered at his house; after digging into his past, police suspect the killer might be close to home; for Josh Mankiewicz, the toxic marriage at the heart of this case makes it unforgettable.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E01 The Last Thanksgiving A Thanksgiving feast turns into a family's last when a cold-blooded killer brutally stabs and dismembers a couple the day after their holiday celebration.

oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E05 One-Way Street Jacquelyn Smith is stabbed to death in Baltimore, in what appears to be a random act of violence; as detectives dig deeper, they uncover a diabolical plan, vicious lies and a killer relationship.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Relationship With Faith Jenkins
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E08 Buried Secrets Popular high school senior Chris Daigle mysteriously disappears from Missouri City, Texas; for nearly a decade, his mother will stop at nothing to get answers while keeping friends close but enemies closer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Relationship With Faith Jenkins
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E09 Medical Mystery When Melissa Henderson is found dead in her bed, a perplexing mystery ensues; her husband and family believe her death is from natural causes, but the clues lead investigators to a secret life of spying and jealousy and ultimately to a killer.

syfy.us.title: The Forever Purge
syfy.us.description: Adela and her husband, Juan, live in Texas, where he works as a ranch hand for the wealthy Tucker family. Juan impresses the Tucker patriarch, Caleb, but that fuels the jealous anger of his son, Dylan. On the morning after the Purge, a masked gang of killers attacks the Tuckers, forcing both families to band together and fight back as the country spirals into chaos. (Action, Thriller, Horror) - 2021

syfy.us.title: Renfield
syfy.us.description: Renfield, the tortured aide to his narcissistic boss, Dracula, is forced to procure his master's prey and do his every bidding. However, after centuries of servitude, he's ready to see if there's a life outside the shadow of the Prince of Darkness. (Horror, Action, Comedy) - 2023

syfy.us.description: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2024

syfy.us.title: Die Hard
syfy.us.description: New York City policeman John McClane is visiting his estranged wife and two daughters on Christmas Eve. He joins her at a holiday party in the headquarters of the Japanese-owned business she works for. But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him. (Action, Thriller) - 1988

wnbdld.us.title: Young Sheldon
wnbdld.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

klst.us.title: AgDay
klst.us.description: Since 1982, "AgDay" has been providing farmers and ranchers news, weather and market information every weekday morning. The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

klst.us.title: Machinery Pete
klst.us.description: Greg Peterson has been covering farm equipment auctions for various industry magazines for more than 20 years and did the same during six seasons of RFD's "Machinery Show." Now Peterson has his own show, which shares its title with his nickname: "Machinery Pete." Each episode features Peterson traveling to a farm machinery auction, where he meets some of the people who attend the sales where items like tractors and skid steers are sold. He also provides his analysis of current and historical trends in the used equipment market and answers viewer questions about what their equipment is worth in the Ask Machinery Pete segment. (Auction) - 2013-11-05

Instead, host Sharyl Attkisson -- a veteran journalist who has won multiple Emmy Awards for investigative journalism -- fronts a newsmagazine-style program that features long-form reports from her and a team of correspondents. cleotv.us.title: Culture Kitchen - Light and Right

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Quiller Memorandum
fxm.us.description: After two British Secret Intelligence Service agents are murdered at the hands of a cryptic neo-Nazi group known as Phoenix, the suave agent Quiller is sent to Berlin to investigate. There, he begins an affair with Inge Lindt, a beautiful young teacher. However, their lives are put in danger after Quiller is kidnapped and taken to Phoenix's headquarters, where he meets Oktober, the mysterious leader of the group. (Thriller) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Gang's All Here
fxm.us.description: The night before his deployment in World War II, wealthy heir Andy Mason (James Ellison) falls in love with Eadie (Alice Faye), a beautiful cabaret singer. The two hit it off, but Mason fails to reveal the fact that he has already promised to marry Vivian (Sheila Ryan), a family friend. When he returns from the war a hero, his father throws a huge party for him, hiring Eadie and her company to perform. Mason hopes to find an out with Vivian in order to marry his true love. (Musical, Romance) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Madame Web
fxm.us.description: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

fxm.us.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
fxm.us.description: Welcome to Raccoon City, once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corp. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland, a dying town with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night. (Horror, Action) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1984

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters II
fxm.us.description: Now the parapsychologists (Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd) are trying to rid New York of stress-related pink slime. - 1989

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, four women (Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones, Kate McKinnon) prepare for an epic battle as mischievous ghosts start to wreak havoc in New York. - 2016

fxm.us.title: Fantastic Voyage
fxm.us.description: A surgical task force is reduced to microbe size to perform a delicate operation inside the brain of a dying scientist. - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Day Mars Invaded Earth
fxm.us.description: A Cape Canaveral scientist finds Martians reducing people to ashes and taking their places. - 1963

fxm.us.title: Black Widow

backstage.us.title: The Substitute
backstage.us.description: Inner-city Miami schoolteacher Jane Hetzko gets her knee broken when she stands up to the school's gang leader, Juan Lacas. Her boyfriend, mercenary combat specialist Jonathan Shale, goes undercover as a substitute teacher to take down the punk, but soon discovers that Lacas is merely an underling for the real criminal mastermind. Assembling the team from his last jungle raid, led by his right-hand man, Joey Six, Shale declares war. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

backstage.us.title: The Substitute 2: School's Out
backstage.us.description: A mercenary with a chip on his shoulder, Karl Thomasson poses as a teacher at an inner-city school to exact revenge on the gang members who murdered his brother. As Thomasson investigates the killing and tries to keep his estranged niece, Anya, safe, he begins to realize how dysfunctional and violent the urban school environment has become. Even with support from fellow soldier Joey Six, Thomasson is seriously outnumbered as he seeks vengeance. (Action) - 1998

backstage.us.title: Sounds of The Streets

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: White Boy Rick
cinevault.us.description: Rick Wershe is a single father who's struggling to raise two teenagers during the height of the crack epidemic in the 1980s Detroit. Wershe sells guns illegally to make ends meet but soon attracts attention from the FBI. Federal agents convince his son, Rick Jr., to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself. (Biography, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-08-31

cinevault.us.title: Anaconda
cinevault.us.description: Filmmaker Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez) is traveling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist (Eric Stoltz) and a cameraman (Ice Cube), come across Paul (Jon Voight), who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it. (Movie, Thriller) - 1997-07-11

cinevault.us.title: Guarding Tess
cinevault.us.description: Doug Chesnic (Nicolas Cage), an agent with the Secret Service Uniformed Division, is assigned to protect former first lady Tess Carlisle (Shirley MacLaine). Chesnic finds the job demeaning and a challenge because of Tess' high-maintenance personality and petty demands. He's desperate to get another assignment, but she insists that he remain head of her security detail, using her influence with the current president to get her way. When she's kidnapped, however, Chesnic's feelings change. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-04-30

cinevault.us.title: Eat Pray Love
cinevault.us.description: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) thought she had everything she wanted in life: a home, a husband and a successful career. Now newly divorced and facing a turning point, she finds that she is confused about what is important to her. Daring to step out of her comfort zone, Liz embarks on a quest of self-discovery that takes her to Italy, India and Bali. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-08-13

cinevault.us.title: Random Hearts

(Drama, Movie) - 1999-10-08

cinevault.us.title: All the King's Men

However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S33 E07 Bedford: Insulation, Roofing Tom Silva adds insulation to the oldest part of the house; landscape designer Jenn Nawada and Roger build raised beds out of old fieldstone and Becky plants the first vegetables. Tom and Kevin waterproof the new roof with a self-sealing membrane.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S33 E08 Bedford: Kitchen Inspiration Replacing a rotted post; reinstalling the restored historic window sashes; upgrading the electrical service in the garage; the house that inspired the kitchen; removing strip flooring to reveal historic boards.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S33 E09 Bedford: A New Driveway Tom installs new red cedar clapboards; Richard helps remove some existing plumbing in the old kitchen; Roger installs a new asphalt driveway that will later be topped with a rustic finish; a wet vent in the powder room.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S13 E08 Harvesting Honey; Adding Outlets Honey harvesting; adding outlets.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S13 E10 New Switch; Tree Care Electrician Scott Caron connects a homeowner's basement lighting system to one switch; Richard shares some tips on air conditioning maintenance; Roger shows how to rejuvenate a crabapple tree; Tom shows Kevin a new way to organize his work gloves.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S13 E16 Tile Paint; New Faucet Kevin heads to Kansas City to help a homeowner transform an old backsplash; Richard helps a homeowner install a new kitchen faucet; Tom walks Kevin through insulation options: spray foam, fiberglass and blown-in cellulose.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S13 E19 Ceiling Fan; Bonsai Electrician Scott Caron helps a homeowner replace an undersized ceiling fan with a more appropriate one; Kevin, Tom, Richard and Roger ask "What is it?"; Roger visits a bonsai nursery to learn the art of sculpting trees.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S13 E20 Lightning; Sink Filter Kevin and Roger meet with Jim Cantore to discuss his biggest weather fear, lightning; Roger heads to Orlando to see a lightning protection system installed; What Is It?; Richard helps a homeowner install a reverse osmosis filter for drinking water.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E12 Weston: Natural Surfaces and the Latest Appliances Installing granite steps on the entry porch and flooring on the first floor; test-driving new appliances before buying them; installing a cure for the cell phone dead zone; a few unexpected options for furnishing a timber frame home.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E14 Weston: LEED Requirements Learning more about the LEED for Homes program and how the Weston house will qualify; how they build window trim kits in the Bensonwood shop and how they are installed at the project house; the new industrial steel staircase.

classica.us.description: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique". (Special, Entertainment, Music, Classical) - 2017-03-27

classica.us.title: Faurés Requiem
classica.us.description: 2024 jährt sich der 100. Todestag von Gabriel Fauré, einem der herausragendsten und einflussreichsten Komponisten, der Lehrer von Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger und vielen anderen war. (Special) - 2026-06-06

classica.us.title: Michail Pletnjow dirigiert Rimski-Korsakow
classica.us.description: Das Russische Nationalorchester spielt unter der Leitung Michail Pletnews. Die Aufsicht des Dirigenten führt zu einem exquisiten Konzert; das Programm der Suiten von Nikolai Rimski-Korsakow wird in der Moskauer Tschaikowsky Konzertsaal aufgeführt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-01-03

classica.us.title: Luisi dirigiert Paganinis Violinkonzert und Brahms
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi ist mit dem Dänischen Radio-Sinfonieorchester aufgetreten. Sie führten Paganinis 1. Violinkonzert und Brahms' dramatisches Sinfonie-Debüt, die 1. Sinfonie, auf. Beide Werke erfreuen sich außerordentlicher Beliebtheit.

classica.us.title: Rachmaninov - Klavierkonzert Nr. 4 und Nielsen 6
classica.us.description: Das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester unter der Leitung von Fabio Luisi spielt Stücke von Rachmaninow und des dänischen Nationalkomponisten Carl Nielsen. Die Solistin des Klavierkonzerts ist die französische Pianistin Lise de la Salle.

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt.

classica.us.title: Mozart - Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 & Sinfonie Nr. 35
classica.us.description: Stefano Conticello dirigiert das Orchester des Teatro Comunale di Bologna in einem Konzert. Es wird mit der Ouvertüre aus Mozarts beliebter Oper "Die Zauberflöte" eröffnet. Es folgt das Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 in C-Dur, mit Maurizio Baglini als Solist.

classica.us.title: Schumann - 3. Klaviersonate, Op. 14
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die dritte Klaviersonate, Op. 14 von Robert Schumann.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
classica.us.description: Der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die Davidsbündlertänze Op. 6. Sie sind eine Gruppe von achtzehn Klavierstücken, die im Jahr 1837 komponiert wurden. Sie sind nach Schumanns Musikgesellschaft, den Davidsbündlern, benannt.

classica.us.title: Shusha Renaissance
classica.us.description: Die Stadt Schuscha wird oft als Wiege der aserbaidschanischen Musik und Poesie und als eines der wichtigsten Zentren der aserbaidschanischen Kultur angesehen. Im Januar 2021 wurde sie zur Kulturhauptstadt Aserbaidschans erklärt.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Klavierquintett in Es-Dur, Op. 44
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Grande Dame des Klaviers, Martha Argerich, dem Kammermusikrepertoire in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgenommen wurde.

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen sich Live-Übertragungen von Konzerten im Fernsehen an, beispielsweise das Neujahrskonzert. Die Dokumentation zeigt, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, einem breiten Publikum klassische Musik näherzubringen. - 2012

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Barockwerke von Bach, Muffat und Rameau
classica.us.description: Paul Goodwin dirigiert das Conjunto Barroco. Auf dem Programm steht unter anderem Muffats Sonata Nr. 5 in G-Dur. Diese Aufführung wurde am 8. Februar 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Reina Sofía Musikschule in Madrid aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. - 2019

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 2
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte.

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt.

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tom Papa: Freaked Out
thestandupchannel.us.description: Papa's comedy special touches on subjects such as the hazards of churches, make-up, loose change, old age, Chinese grocery stores, raising women and magical gnomes.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford: The Comedy Vaccine (Extended Edition)
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic performs his fifth stand-up comedy special in Tempe, Ariz., focusing on COVID-19 and offering his views on mask culture, fatherhood and why 2020 was the best year to fart in public.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
thestandupchannel.us.description: Yang dives into love languages, loser friends and negotiating with his Asian parents.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
thestandupchannel.us.description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs his most popular characters, including Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, and Bubba J, while discussing topics such as Hollywood, politics and romance.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Keith Robinson Back of the Bus Funny
thestandupchannel.us.description: Keith Robinson describes the long-term dangers of being racist, the pitfalls of aging and the difference between the ways that men and women cheat.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jim Breuer: Let's Clear the Air
Jim Breuer: And Laughter for All
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Jim Breuer deals with being a middle-aged dad in suburbia.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Alonzo Bodden: Who's Paying Attention?
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic discusses the decline of civilization, the rise of pop culture, and swine flu.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S04 E08 Too Far Gone Things finally begin to calm at the prison until Rick and the group face imminent danger when the Governor arrives with his forces.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S04 E09 After Rick and Carl look for shelter while Rick deals with old wounds; those left at the prison consider whether survival alone will be enough.

travel.us.description: The team takes on poltergeist activity connected to a gruesome murder in Berwick, La.; the case hits close to home after they link a baby doll from the crime scene to paranormal activity at their own headquarters. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghosts of Morgan City - Haunted Headquarters
travel.us.description: The team uncovers the shocking history behind the location of their headquarters after an alarm is tripped at Morgan City's archives building; a surprise witness turns their investigation on its head. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghosts of Morgan City - The Man in Black
travel.us.description: The team investigates downtown Morgan City after construction workers discover skeletal remains under the street; they turn to the community for help putting the town's spirits to rest. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Pasadena Ritual House
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate the Pasadena, Calif., home of a self-proclaimed Satanist; a séance conducted inside the historic Victorian house reveals that an inhuman presence has attached itself to Aaron and is trying to communicate with him. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Franklin Castle
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew travel to Cleveland to investigate the most-haunted residence in Ohio; whispers of murder, suicide and arson have led many to believe the majestic mansion carries a deadly curse. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Nightmare in Antelope
travel.us.description: A demonic entity that's tearing a family apart and an exorcism may be the only way to save them from the dark and powerful forces plaguing their home. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Haunted Hollow Forest
travel.us.description: Reports of a mysterious gray entity haunting an ancient plot of land in West Haven, Utah; evidence that suggests the paranormal creature originated with a shaman's curse. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - The Chinatown Poltergeist
travel.us.description: Poltergeist activity at a Las Vegas tiki bar; the staff believes a horrendous shooting on the property in 1995 may be responsible for recent sightings of moving objects, flying shadow figures and a ghost girl. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Disturbed in Wickenburg
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew return to Vulture City to confront an ancient evil. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - The Joshua Tree Inn
travel.us.description: Zak, Aaron, Billy, and Jay investigate California's Joshua Tree Inn, where singer-songwriter Gram Parsons died in 1973; singer Loren Gray joins the investigation to help find answers behind the eerie and unexplained activity plaguing the inn. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Mayhem in Millville
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate a Utah home owned by a descendant of the prominent Jessop polygamist family; tenants fear evil has taken up residence in the basement, putting the guys in serious danger. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Benson Grist Mill
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew travel to Utah to investigate a 150-year-old grist mill haunted by shadow figures, poltergeist activity and an angry male presence. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Lost Souls Of The Berkeley
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew board a steam ferry from the 1800s to investigate escalating paranormal activity; the staff fears something dark has awakened on the historical vessel after lying dormant for months during the COVID-19 pandemic. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Meaning of Evolution
truehistory.us.description: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Way It Used to Be
truehistory.us.description: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Self-Interest, Human Survival, and History
truehistory.us.description: Differences between economic history and a history of economics; the primary concerns of current economic historians; watershed economic moments of the last 500 years; why modern economic history begins around 1400. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade
truehistory.us.description: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - 1990: America's New World Order
truehistory.us.description: The end of the Cold War is a key point in history; the rapid collapse of the Soviet Union; the fall of the Berlin Wall; delving into the American story in the early 1990s; conflicts in Kuwait and Bosnia test America's new role in a post-Soviet world. (History, Educational) - 2020-02-28

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - The Clintons and the 1990s
truehistory.us.description: Bill Clinton's presidency dominates the domestic news in the 1990s. From his dramatic showdown with Newt Gingrich and the Republican Congress's Contract with America, this is a presidency of high drama; surveying the tumultuous decade. (History, Educational) - 2020-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Reflections On and of Pompeii
truehistory.us.description: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
truehistory.us.description: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - 1865: \"Bind Up the Nation's Wounds\"
truehistory.us.description: The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War. (American history) - 2015-05-01

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - The Reconstruction Revolution
truehistory.us.description: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites. (American history) - 2015-05-01

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Land of Canaan
truehistory.us.description: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Arrival of the Israelites
truehistory.us.description: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Jerusalem of David and Solomon
truehistory.us.description: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Biblical Jerusalem's Ancient Water Systems
truehistory.us.description: The City of David's ancient water system centered on the Gihon Spring; the three different water systems that are created due to the spring's location outside the city walls; these include Warren's Shaft, Siloam Channel and Hezekiah's Tunnel. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Samaria and the Northern Kingdom of Israel
truehistory.us.description: Learning about Israel as it is ruled under the Omride dynasty between Solomon's death and the Assyrian invasion in 722 B.C.E.; exploring ruins such as the High Place at Dan; the acropolis at Samaria, which holds the remains of King Ahab's palace. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Fortifications and Cult Practices
truehistory.us.description: Aspects of everyday life in the kingdoms of ancient Israel; how recessed gates are designed to protect cities from enemies; how altars, amulets, painted figures and pottery vessels reflect the religious beliefs at Kuntillet Ajrud and other sites.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - From Jesus to the Creation of the Church
truehistory.us.description: In the early days of the Christian faith, there is no church; no single institution to guide the followers of Jesus; stepping into the world of the early church; the roots of Christianity as found in ancient Jewish traditions and the gospel.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - The First Christian Institutions
truehistory.us.description: In the first century A.D., the followers of Christ evolve from a band of disciples into tight-knit communities of worship; a glimpse of these communities in some of the earliest Christian documents; the Acts of the Apostles and the letters of Paul.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - Christianities in the Early Church
truehistory.us.description: Christianity quickly spreads all over the Mediterranean region in the first few centuries; learning how believers adapt the practice of their faith to create a great diversity of worship in the early church.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - Persecution and Saints
truehistory.us.description: The Christian church catches the attention of the Roman emperor; he views the faithful as a threat to imperial authority and Roman culture; the widespread persecution of Christians that follows; a new class of Christian heroes, the martyred saints.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - Peace between Empire and Church
truehistory.us.description: In 312 A.D., Christianity gains a powerful ally when the Roman emperor Constantine adopts the faith of Jesus as his own; seeing how this shift affects Christian believers; the church goes from being a persecuted minority to a privileged minority.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Biblical Israel - The Story of a People
truehistory.us.description: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile
truehistory.us.description: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Ancestor Narratives in Genesis
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the stories of ancient Israel's origins as preserved in the Book of Genesis; these origin stories are crucial for understanding the books that follow because ancient Israel understands itself to be a family that descends from Jacob.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Moses - The Torah's Central Hero
truehistory.us.description: A look at Moses; the story of the Israelites' exodus from Egypt; tracing the narrative of Moses's journey, which includes receiving the Ten Commandments from Yahweh; reviewing the Torah, the "law of Moses"; the origins of the priesthood.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Land of Canaan
truehistory.us.description: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Arrival of the Israelites
truehistory.us.description: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Jerusalem of David and Solomon
truehistory.us.description: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Biblical Jerusalem's Ancient Water Systems
truehistory.us.description: The City of David's ancient water system centered on the Gihon Spring; the three different water systems that are created due to the spring's location outside the city walls; these include Warren's Shaft, Siloam Channel and Hezekiah's Tunnel.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Samaria and the Northern Kingdom of Israel
truehistory.us.description: Learning about Israel as it is ruled under the Omride dynasty between Solomon's death and the Assyrian invasion in 722 B.C.E.; exploring ruins such as the High Place at Dan; the acropolis at Samaria, which holds the remains of King Ahab's palace.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh and the beautiful prisoner he is transporting are on a three day trip while her partner is still on the loose. For once Josh may not follow through on obeying the law as they fall in love.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged. The dangerous prisoners escape and appoint themselves the law, after the town is hit by a tornado, killing the sheriff.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: A journalist accompanies Josh on his manhunt to get an exclusive story on a bounty hunter. Josh agrees to let him join him in the hunt for Jack Torrance but finds they have different methods.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh feels compelled to repay a debt to an old friend who's in jail and may hang. However, the friend escapes, forcing Josh to go on the hunt for him until it appears he died when he went over a cliff

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh brings in outlaw Carlos Domingo, but he has to be released when the witness against him is killed. Josh concocts a surprise witness to testify against the notorious killer - his own mother.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh is sent for by the desperate men of Coronado. He is hired to convince the women of the town to come back to their men when they leave demanding that all towns men give up their guns for good.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh brings in a man wanted for robbery but loses his reward. A well meaning doctor pays an innocent man to take the blame for his son, but the son sets out to kill the man to make sure he never tells

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh arrives in a town for rest just as the local bank has been robbed. A traveling medicine man knows the whereabouts of the suspect and wants Josh to help because he thinks the suspect is innocent.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son. Josh served under her husband in the war. His mother now is trying to steal her grandson to take over the family fortune.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score. He wants to catch a young outlaw who shot him in the leg.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: In Mexico, Josh is hired to protect a man and his pregnant wife from his the villagers who are angered when he refuses the town healing woman or "witch" from being present when his wife gives birth.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: After Josh takes the task of finding a man and his wife's pet ewe, he becomes the butt of many jokes while cattlemen nearly hang him when he mentions sheep. His only clue is a gold bell the ewe wore.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: When a convicted killer escapes prison, Josh is hired to protect the woman whose testimony put him there. The woman's husband is a lawyer who says he has always been a coward and never carries a gun.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh rides into a town looking for a man who wants to hire him. When he goes to the man's room at the hotel, Josh is shot. He must figure out who shot him but the sheriff is ordering him out of town.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: Josh is hired by Harry Weaver to track down his twin brother Pete, a wanted man. Harry is tired of being used by Pete, plus the law and bounty hunters are apt to mistake him for Pete.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
680705.description: A broke Josh is hired by a fearful man to help him elope with his sweetheart, Jane, the daughter of a local rancher. The girl's father is vehemently opposed to the marriage.

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

680705.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
