700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn on the horizon, the seasonal planting of bulbs for spring-flowering begins at Longmeadow. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don tackles the perennial problem of what to grow in the shade beneath a tree, Carol Klein takes a look at the crocosmia and we meet a gardener in Derbyshire who has spent a lifetime growing and showing gladioli.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn just around the corner, Adam takes stock of his garden and plans ahead for some late-season interest under the supervision of Ash the cat. Plus, Frances visits a garden in Kent where the plants provide a non-stop buffet for insects.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow this week, Monty reaps a harvest from the vegetable garden, plants up a seasonal pot and gives a masterclass on how to make the perfect compost. Adam Frost travels to York to meet a couple who took on 20 acres of land and filled it with flowers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The vegetable garden is at its peak now and as well as harvesting, Monty takes a look at how his autumn crops are faring as well as giving tips on how to keep the garden looking at its best. Adam Frost returns to Leicester where he has been helping to create a garden from scratch on a new build estate, and Frances Tophill celebrates the summer harvest on her shared allotment.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond celebrate the horticultural genius of William Robinson in the gardens of his former home, Gravetye Manor in Sussex. Fresh off the back of her success at Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival, Sue Kent gives her own garden some TLC and creates a special container display using small pots. There's also a passionate grower in London who uses every available space in his garden to grow a vast range of vegetables.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don prepares the flowering borders for winter and makes a bonfire, Carol celebrates our berry-laden hedgerows, and Rachel visits Julian Clary in his garden.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Four inmates from a Delaware Correctional Center turn up missing in the middle of the night. A few hours later, a stolen vehicle is recovered; inside, one of the inmate's fingerprints is found, as well as the address book of one of the other fugitives. A multi-state manhunt ensues with the help of the FBI. A nearby robbery report is the agent's first tip, followed by a murder in the same neighborhood.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the Spring of 1997, a killer preying on senior citizens terrorizes the River Parish area of Southern Louisiana. By May, local police and the New Orleans FBI are exploring a connection between the April 9 murder of a 71-year old widow and the May 9 murder of a retired couple. A month later, authorities forward information on the crimes to the FBI's Behavioral Science Unit in Quantico, VA, hoping a profile will help them narrow the field of possible suspects.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On December 21, 1998, two gunmen kidnap three janitors on their way to clean the Bank of America ATM repository in Las Vegas. The gunmen force the janitors to let them in the ATM repository and hold them hostage until the armored car guards arrive to make their nightly collection. When the guards enter the bank, the gunmen surprise them and shoot one guard in the chest before escaping with $1,088,000, the largest bank robbery take in Las Vegas history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Henderson, NV, a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambush armored guards as they exit their truck on March 3, 2000. The robbers kill both guards and seize $5,000. As the killers run to their getaway car, a police officer arrives and opens fire, striking one escaping assailant in the leg. After loosing the killers in a chase, police collect blood left by the injured robber and bullet casings from the firefight.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 12, 1997, two men use a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, NJ home. The homeowner shoots at the intruders, hitting one in the hand before they escape. Camden Police respond and track the suspects to a nearby park. One of the men shoots at the officer before police arrest his accomplice. The man gives up the identity of the shooter. Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When violent criminals strike, the FBI strikes back, employing every available resource, and creating new ones when necessary. From forensic science to criminal profiling, specialized intelligence to global fugitive tracking, the agents of the FBI battle the bad guys with a most powerful arsenal: the crime-fighter's toolbox. This special episode of The FBI Files celebrates the groundbreaking science, investigative technique, and gut-level instinct that has made the FBI the world's premier law enforcement agency.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1970's, Otpor, a violent arm of the Croatian National Resistance commits terroristic acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the U.S. With the help of an informant, the FBI is able to apprehend, arrest and convict members of the group for crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area. The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders. Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes. The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors. All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence. FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 70s and early 80s, a terrorist group known as the FALN is suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities. Their goal - to bring attention to the Puerto Rican independence movement. As the bombings escalate, innocent lives are lost. FBI agents and police are is in a deadly race to stop this murderous group with a dangerous cause.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power leads to a full-scale mob war. The local Mafia crime family splits in two as the young and the old fight to the death. The FBI is caught in the middle as they infiltrate the syndicate through informants and high-tech surveillance. Agents must find a way to bring down the organization before their civil war leads to innocent causalities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1980s, the FBI matches wits with a cunning bank robber -- a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history. The robber's planning is meticulous. He executes his crimes with military precision. It will take the combined skills of local police and dozens of agents to catch a criminal mastermind they call, "The Shootist."

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Puerto Rico, violent militants are intent on turning the US Commonwealth into a communist dictatorship. They murder a policeman, turns their guns on a busload of unarmed Navy workers, and even launch an attack on the FBI. These ruthless killers have vowed to fight to the death. The FBI must use every tactic at their disposal to track down the terrorists and bring them to justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1980s, the drug trade ravages Chicago's inner city neighborhoods and violent crime threatens to destroy entire communities. As drug profits grow, gangs rule the streets. One of the most dangerous is the El Rukns. FBI Agents team up with state and local police to bring them down, but in the process, uncover a bizarre and frightening terrorist plot.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary. The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy. The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack. Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports. One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel. The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1980's the New York City Police Department is fighting a losing battle in the war on drugs. Distributors and drug gangs in New York are making millions, and they will do anything to protect their profits. After two law enforcement officers are targeted, hundreds of police officers and FBI agents devise a bold plan to crackdown on the drug gangs and shut down their deadly business.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1999, Police investigate two brutal murders in two small towns located hundreds of miles apart. The crimes seem random and unrelated, until investigators discover a terrifying link. Local police and the FBI must untangle a web of liesto stop a dangerous gang that will kill a man for his Identity.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot. The gunman was desperate to stay free, a threat to anyone in his way. The FBI and U.S. marshals teamed up to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, Seven inmates break out of a high security prison in New Mexico. The escapees, all violent criminals, are a threat to anyone who crosses their path. State and local police and the FBI know they must capture these men before they rob, rape and kill…again.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Born in El Paso, Texas, on February 29, 1960, Richard Ramirez was an American serial killer who over a two-year rampage raped and tortured more than 25 victims and murdered more than a dozen, most of them in their own homes.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: An in-depth look at some of the world's most dangerous murderers.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Criminologists, forensic pathologists, federal agents, and other experts delve into the lives of the most terrifying and notorious killers in history.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Cary Stayner is a serial killer who murdered four women at Yosemite National Park and was the product of a uniquely tragic background; in 1972, Stayner's brother, Steven, was abducted by child molester Kenneth Parnell but Steven escaped.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Serial killer Edmund Kemper killed six young women in the Santa Cruz, Calif. area and several members of his family; at the age of 15, he killed both his grandparents to see what it felt like.

400000093.description: The disturbing and horrifying case of Horst Kroener, a 53-year-old German man who was jailed in 2016 for brutally murdering his wife when she was asleep in their bed.

400000093.description: From October 1989 to April 1991, Wolfgang Schmidt murdered five women and an infant; the area where some of the crimes took place leads to a second moniker, "the Beast of Beelitz."

400000093.description: A look at serial killer Jack Unterweger.

400000093.description: Danilo Restivo, originally from Italy, was jailed for murdering and mutilating his Bournemouth neighbor, Heather Barnett, in 2002.

400000093.description: An examination of the Polish serial killer who came to be known as The Scorpion.

400000093.description: Craig Bjork, who killed two women and both of his children, remains a dangerous threat — even behind bars.

400000093.description: Whilst being transported on a bus, Ricky Dubose killed two correctional officers before going on the run.

400000093.description: After cold-blooded killer Leo Boatman murdered two campers, he went on the kill three inmates behind bars.

400000093.description: Jesse Con-ui's loyalty to the New Mexican Mafia drove him to betray and murder his former mentor.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: A fugitive from the United States tackles the British police and goes on the run.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: The Alaska serial killer Robert Hansen who murdered at least seventeen women during a spree that lasted for more than a decade.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: A master manipulator accused of his wife's murder is eventually caught by a polygraph test.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: A jailing for the shocking murder of author Helen Bailey leads to a second conviction of another.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Steven Dean Gordon and Frank Cano murder at least four sex workers in California between 2012 and 2013.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: In January 1973, 20-year-old mother of one Dawn Magyar vanishes while on a shopping trip in Owosso, Michigan.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Randy Kraft, a well-spoken, well-respected computer expert...and a prolific serial killer.

400000093.description: Richard Kuklinski claims to have murdered over 100 people for New York and New Jersey's crime families.

673498.title: Reprisal!
673498.description: Frank Madden (Guy Madison), who is part Native American but passes as white, purchases a ranch in the small town of Kendall, Okla. When Frank moves in, he finds that the bigoted townspeople have recently let three brothers, who are also his neighbors, get away with the lynching murder of innocent Native Americans. As tensions between the townspeople and local Native Americans rise, Hank becomes torn between fighting against injustice and keeping his true identity a secret.

673498.title: Forbidden Trail
673498.description: A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.

673498.title: The Professionals
673498.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement.

673498.title: Battle of Rogue River
673498.description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

673498.title: Santa Fe
673498.description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

673498.title: The Wild Westerners
673498.description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

673498.title: Gunman's Walk
673498.description: Rancher Lee Hackett (Van Heflin) spends so much time trying to keep the violent streak of his son Ed (Tab Hunter) in check, he neglects the needs of his other son Davy (James Darren). When Ed's temper results in the death of an innocent Native American, Lee tries his best to cover his son's tracks by making a deal with unscrupulous horse trader Jensen (Ray Teal), who falsely testifies on Ed's behalf. But it becomes clear that Ed can't change, and a shootout between father and son ensues.

673498.title: Indian Uprising
673498.description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

673498.title: The Gun That Won the West
673498.description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

673498.title: King of the Wild Horses
673498.description: A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.

673498.title: Relentless
673498.description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

673498.title: Ambush at Tomahawk Gap
673498.description: Flaming arrows stop four ex-convicts searching a ghost town for their buried loot.

673498.title: The Hard Man
673498.description: A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Police patrolling the night streets hear gunshots and head to the scene. They find a nude middle-aged man in parking lot lying face down in a puddle of blood.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: While in the process of adopting a five-week-old baby, a mother takes him to work with her. While there, the baby inexplicably obtains a skull fracture while unsupervised.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen. Clues found near the body include an empty cash register, a knife and a trail of blood splotches leading to a vandalized car in the parking lot.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A healthy 53-year-old woman is found dead in bed. After performing an autopsy and taking blood and tissue samples, Dr. G cannot find the cause of death.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn't what it seems.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple haven't seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Melissa Riobe's life is ruled by her addiction to drugs. Now, the 42-year-old woman has learned how to buy powerful prescription drugs online without a doctor's note.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Recent college grad Robert Terrible is out drinking at a club with friends celebrating. At 3am, he realizes he better call it a night and heads to the nearby garage where he parked his car.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: It's an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a short-cut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can't believe his eyes.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: It is 3am and Deputy Torres is cruising a Texas highway when he suddenly spots a crushed pick-up truck along the side of the road. Trapped inside is the lifeless body of 24-year-old Luis Reyes.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Carol Moleskie agrees to go on a hunting excursion with her husband, Bob. A few hours after they enter the woods, they emerge again, Bob frantically waving down traffic as he carries his bloody wife.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: It's a late night and a Vietnam veteran with a history of mental illness is drunk and stumbling through an apartment complex. When the police arrive, he pulls a gun and shoots himself in the head.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: When the husband, Tao Chen, is shot to death by his wife Jun, she claims she pulled the trigger in self-defense when a drunken Tao came after her with a gun.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: After a brief illness, 34-year old Claire Jackson dies suddenly in the hospital from massive liver failure and winds up in Dr. G's morgue.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A quadriplegic woman loved by her community is found dead in an Orlando park 150ft from her motorized wheelchair. Children find her lifeless body face down in the sand.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Jerra Kirby, who's visiting family in Orlando, has suddenly passed out at a theme park wave pool and the paramedics are trying desperately to revive her.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Chris Schaffer has not been seen or heard from in five days. Finally, his friends find him dead and decomposed in the driver's seat of his van.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Ricky Hawthorne, a middle-aged man with a history of AIDS, arrives at his local hospital complaining of chest pains. Doctors perform extensive tests on him but find nothing wrong and release him.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Police are driving down the street when a man suddenly jumps in front of their car. They screech to a halt and avoid hitting him, but the man is highly agitated.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Teenagers stumble across a horrifying car fire on the side of a desolate stretch of roadway. When the police arrive, they pull severely burned human remains from the driver's seat.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A retired military officer is found dead in his own backyard during a freak ice storm in San Antonio, Texas.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Dr. G. has just graduated from medical school and is set to begin her first job as an M.E. in Jacksonville, Florida when a high-profile case challenges her to use her newly acquired skills.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Manny Alvarez mysteriously crashes his car into a fence. He dies en route to the hospital, leaving behind a wife and son. It is up to Dr. G to find out what cut this young man's life short.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A diabetic man dies after a night out. Meanwhile, an elderly man's decomposing body is found in his son's home. Dr. G realizes that finding the causes of death will be anything but straight-forward.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is back in Denver and in hot pursuit of a woman wanted for identity theft. The sad reality is that the identify which has been robbed is her own. She's traded in a bright future for a life on the wrong side of the law.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Being hunted by the Dog is a lousy way to celebrate your birthday but that's exactly the spot that Robert finds himself in today. He's missed his court date, quit his job, and vacated his last known address.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Kimo does a vanishing act for his day in court and now Dog and the posse have to find him. With precious few leads to follow Dog turns to the fugitive's on again-off-again girlfriend, but she's initially reluctant to join the hunt.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today Dog and the family are back in Colorado and are about to make one of their most exciting captures ever. On his search he'll encounter a felon with history of violence and an alleged affection for sawed-off shotguns.

400000088.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and the Chapman clan start their hunt today.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today Dog is back in Hawaii confronted with two alleged felons who are in crisis. Family and friends of these bondees are convinced that they are getting into further trouble while awaiting trial.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Facing hard time for forging checks, Melissa pulled a vanishing act at her sentencing hearing, bolting from the courthouse in broad daylight. Lucky for her bondsman, Dog and his posse are in Colorado and ready to help.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is busy. First he's after a fugitive who is allegedly an expert in the game of "burn and return"--shoplifting goods to return them for cash refunds. But he's not easy to track.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Going after two fugitives in one day is tough enough without the facing Colorado's notoriously unpredictable weather. Today it's the threat of sever thunderstorm, hail and area wide tornado warnings.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

400000088.description: Both brother Tim and fellow Honolulu bondsman James need Dog's help to track down their hard to find fugitives. The two cases on the docket today are challenging, especially the hunt for Gregory, a felon with a lengthy rap sheet.

400000088.description: It's Beth's birthday and Dog knows just what she needs, whether she knows it or not! He surprises Beth with Delilah, a Papillion puppy small enough to sit in the palm of her hand.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today Leland and Dog make a quick visit to the police supply store to get some new gadgets for the team. But they can't linger because they've also got a fugitive to catch. Their target is reputed to have an explosive temper.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When an offender with a long record ducks his day in court, Bobby Brown knows whom to call--The Dog! And knowing that few souls can resist Beth's clever persuasion, Dog gives her the job of luring the fugitive in.

692051.title: Day of the Dead
692051.description: A group of scientists and soldiers take refuge in an underground missile silo desperate to control the flesh-eating horror roaming the earth above.

692051.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
692051.description: After spending years on the run with her father, Heather discovers her true identity, which has made her the target of a dangerous cult.

692051.title: Nightbreed
692051.description: Aaron Boone (Craig Sheffer) is haunted by terrifying nightmares of a city of monsters. He goes to see a psychiatrist, Dr. Decker (David Cronenberg), for help. But what Boone doesn't know is that Decker is really a serial killer. Decker frames Boone to take the fall for his murders, and Boone is killed by the police. But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

692051.title: Alligator
692051.description: After it’s flushed down the toilet, a baby alligator grows to monstrous size as it prowls the city sewers. Chaos erupts when it comes to the surface.

692051.title: Piranha
692051.description: When flesh-eating piranhas are accidentally released into a summer resort's rivers, the guests become their next meal.

692051.title: The Nest
692051.description: The quiet town of North Port is being overrun by cockroaches, and its sheriff is pinning the blame on the INTEC Corporation’s genetic experiments.

692051.title: Masters of Horror
692051.description: "Always expect the unexpected" is the chilling advice a young woman (Bree Turner of TV's GRIMM) thinks about one night on a lonely stretch of mountain road.

692051.title: Masters of Horror
692051.description: A burned-out cop is demoted to the "weird calls" desk until a series of men are killed by massive blunt-force trauma while in a state of sexual arousal.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: Family man is in a bad accident. As he hovers between life and death, the guy in the bed next to him, a serial killer, switches bodies with him.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: A private investigator is hired to spy on a woman's husband - she suspects he's having an affair. He holes up in a house across the street, but soon begins to hear and see weird things and comes to think the house he's in is haunted.

692051.title: Prom Night
692051.description: Six years after a tragic accident, a masked killer hunts the teens responsible, turning their high school prom into a night of terror.

692051.title: Prom Night II: Hello Mary Lou
692051.description: Decades after promiscuous teen Mary Lou Maloney (Lisa Schrage) dies during a prank gone wrong, she returns as a spirit out for revenge and eager to punish the culprit, her one-time boyfriend, Billy Nordham (Michael Ironside), who is now high-school principal. Evil Mary Lou is perfectly content to kill other locals, and she eventually possesses the body of prom queen contender Vicki Carpenter (Wendy Lyon), which allows her to wreak even more havoc.

692051.title: Prom Night 4 - Deliver Us from Evil
692051.description: Two teenage couples have a terrible time with a killer monk who has escaped from his cell.

692051.title: Black Christmas
692051.description: Sorority sisters are as good as dead when they're stalked by a psychopathic stranger over the Christmas holiday in this influential slasher.

10shakeperth.au.title: Big Brother
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E10 Episode 10 Housemates compete to win $250,000, under Big Brother's constant watchful eye.

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E13 Mud Bowl / Gerald Moves Out Arnold and his fourth-grade friends play the seemingly unbeatable fifth graders in touch football. // Gerald is feeling so neglected that he moves into Arnold's boarding house.

10shakeperth.au.title: T.U.F.F Puppy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E20 The Spelling Bee / House Broken The Wannabee snatches all the kids at the spelling bee and challenges Dudley to a spelling competition. // While TUFF is away travelling, Snaptrap breaks into Keswick's house to steal his latest invention, the head shrinker.

10shakeperth.au.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E19 Pizza Face Mikey discovers that a new mutant is trying to attack and capture people using living pizzas, but he struggles to convince the others who don't believe him.

10shakeperth.au.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E20 The Legend Of The Kuro Kabuto Leo, worried about Karai, tries to convince the others to rescue her, while a master thief steals Shredder's helmet, and it falls into the Turtles' unsuspecting hands.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E5 Mermaid Man And Barnacle Boy Iv/ Doing Time SpongeBob gets a hold of Mermaid Man's utility belt and accidentally shrinks all of Bikini Bottom. // Ms. Puff takes the blame for an accident SpongeBob caused and goes to prison.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E6 The Snowball Effect/ One Krab's Trash It's snowing! SpongeBob and Patrick try to show Squidward how much fun it can be to play in the snow. // Mr. Krabs has a garage sale and sells SpongeBob the most valuable of items.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E3 Googly Eyes Gabby receives a jar of googly eyes that comes with a warning: Don't shake the jar of googly eyes or you'll be in for a troublemaking surprise.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E12 Blazing Amazing Stories Blaze and AJ are babysitting for Baby Gherkin! When it's time for her nap, they tell her three epic bedtime stories about police, cowboys, and superheroes - all starring Blaze and his friends!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E13 Big Rig Blaze A windstorm blows away the supplies for Stripes' Animal Party, Blaze transforms into the one Monster Machine strong enough to haul it all back - a Big Rig! There's nothing he can't pull with it!

10shakeperth.au.title: DORA
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E11 The Great Abuela Cookoff / Missing Map After the Pokey Pigeons eat all of Abuela's elotes, Dora and Boots set out to find more ingredients / Dora, Boots and Backpack play an adventurous game of Hide-and-Seek to find Map.

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E12 Tongue Twisted Troll / Chompy And The Cloud Flower Dora and Boots help Grumpy Old Troll untwist his tongue with Quickatoo's help / Dora and Boots help Chompy find another Cloud Flower Seed after he accidentally eats Isa's.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E16 Meet The Wub Wubs / Invinci-Bubble William loves a bubbly new singing group called the Wub Wubs, but Baby isn't feeling the Wub. / Baby tries to stay safe by living inside a bubble.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E17 Holders Keepers / The Nickname King When William and Chucks both want the same toy, they compete to see who can hold onto it the longest. / Chucks is great at giving out new nicknames, but Baby likes the name he has already.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E3 Playtime at Tolee's Everyone's going over to Tolee's boat house to play, and Kai-Lan invites us, too! All the friends have a great time... until Rintoo accidentally rips Tolee's new panda painting.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 The Moon Festival Hoho is thrilled because he's finally old enough to stay awake for the Chinese Moon Festival.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E2 Pups Meet The Cat Pack When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the Paw Patrol calls in the Cat Pack to help stop the creature.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E3 Cat Pack/ Paw Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers / Save The Golden Lion Mask Cat-Pack members Wild & Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket. // Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade & Wild help the Paw Patrol get it back.

10shakeperth.au.title: Unicorn Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E1 Under The Fairy Moon Pt. 2 While gathering starburst flowers for the Fairy Moon ball, an accident breaks Isabel's trust in River, allowing a mysterious stranger to step in.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E2 True Fairy Friends A Fairy Fly comes to stay in the Fairy Tail Garden. But before they arrive, the Gabby Cats and the little fairy Luli-loo have to show they are true fairy friends by being kind, helpful and welcoming.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E5 The Crew Builds A North Pole Village / The Crew Builds A Giant Dreidel Santa's coming to visit! But when Speed Meister tricks him into stopping at the wrong place, Rubble & Crew have to save Santa./ Rubble & Crew make Builder Cove's big Hanukkah celebration even bigger.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E6 The Crew Fixes The Observatory / The Crew Builds A Meow Yard Rubble & Crew are ready to replace the broken telescope lens at the Observatory. / Cafe Carl's kittens cause construction chaos in the Bark Yard! Can the crew stop the cat chaos?

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E15 How's The Weather? Monte and Margarita review with the Learning Tree and it's Gardener Tim everything about the weather, they talk about the windy, rainy, and sunny days and their differences.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E3 Pups Save A Melon Festival / Pups Save A Cow Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his melon bounces away, causing chaos all over town!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E4 Pups Save The Honey / Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it - and her beehive - go missing from her farm!

10shakeperth.au.title: Henry Danger
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E26 Visible Brad Captain Man and Kid Danger are going to need a little bit of magic and some help from an old friend if they want to catch a thief.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Creature Cases
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E8 The Case Of The Blue Bandit / The Honey Badger Break-In The pals search for the culprit who nabbed a crab's spiral shell home. // Sweetie the honey badger sneaks onto Sam and Kit's bee-infested aircraft.

10shakeperth.au.title: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E16 Mall Ya Later A mall gets built around the treehouse. Banana needs to make a quick buck to buy his toy gun. Goat operates a wizarding kiosk. Cricket gets stuck managing a Jorts store. Pig goes to the movies.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E8 Pat's A Li'l Sinker/camp Spongebob Mrs. Puff gives swimming lessons to Patrick after realizing he never got his swim badge. // SpongeBob finds himself all alone in the camp, but that doesn't stop him from having a blast.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E11 Thanks But No Thanksgiving The Stars celebrate Thanksgiving with Bunny's side of the family in Klopnod.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E13 So Many Lessons Playing baseball isn't another one of Dylan's interests, but when he decides he wants to quit, he has to hide the decision from the family. Rebecca has to choose something for her class time capsule.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E14 Haunted Halls Dylan and Charlie decorate the school for a Halloween party, but discover that the creepy janitor might be keeping a spooky secret. Rebecca and Bethany can't agree on a costume for trick-or-treating.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rock Paper Scissors
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E16 Resolutions / Paper's Book Club Paper makes Scissors feel bad for not doing his New Year's resolution. // In order to feel smart, Paper puts together a book club with the least intelligent people he knows.

10shakeperth.au.title: Max & the Midknights
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E9 A False Victory Max & the Midknights victoriously return to Byjovia with the missing Gnomes of Tresk, but Max feels that their mission isn't over yet.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E10 Get Rod No one likes Rod, especially the Turtles! Bishop's former intern keeps trying to kidnap them and steal their mutant blood, but when Rod himself is kidnapped... Mikey is on the case!

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E7 As Seen On Tv/ Can You Spare A Dime SpongeBob makes a one second cameo in a Krusty Krabs commercial. // Fed up with Mr. Krabs insults, Squidward quits his job - but has a hard time finding a new job.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E8 No Weenies Allowed/ Squilliam Returns SpongeBob must prove that he's tough so he can get into the Salty Spittoon. // Squidward's arch nemesis, Squilliam, returns to harass Squidward about his failed life since high school.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E9 Krab Borg! / Rock-A-Bye Bivalve After watching a movie where robots take over the world, SpongeBob thinks Mr. Krabs is a robot. // SpongeBob and Patrick find a baby clam and decide to raise it as their own.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E10 Wet Painters/ Krusty Krab Training Video SpongeBob and Patrick must paint Mr. Krabs living room without getting a drop of paint on anything but the walls. // Learn how to become a Krusty Krab employee in this episode.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E22 Sterling And Karrueche Tran Lxxii On this episode of Ridiculousness, Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim, and Karrueche Tran keep a safe distance from DODGE BALL DESTROYERS, and get missed by the attempted punches in AIR KNUCKLES.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E11 Sterling And Rocsi Diaz Xxvii On Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Rocsi Diaz hang out with some COOL BOUNCERS, celebrate people with heads of steel in DESTRUCTO-SKULLS, and get messy when taking a couple DIRT BATHS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E24 Sterling And Rocsi Diaz Xxviii Rob, Steelo, and Rocsi Diaz learn the dangers of being over encouraged in YOU DON'T GOT THIS, then check out some enemies of technology in ROBO HATERS, before meeting angry Englanders in BRITISH FURY.

10shakeperth.au.title: Sam Pang Tonight

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Scotland v New Zealand
itvmeridian.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Scotland face New Zealand at Murrayfield. Scotland have never beaten New Zealand, it's a run that goes back 121 years and stretches 33 matches. Last year, Gregor Townsend's side recovered from 17-0 down at half time to draw level with the All Blacks but a late try from Damian McKenzie helped maintain New Zealand's long unbeaten run against Scotland. (Rugby)

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v Japan
itvmeridian.uk.description: Lauren Salter is joined by guests Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton for live rugby from round four of the Nations Championship as Wales host Japan at the Principality Stadium. Wales are looking to make a winning start against Eddie Jones' Japan side, who they beat by a single point in Cardiff a year ago. Every point will be crucial ahead of two tough fixtures against New Zealand and Australia, which will close out the Northern Series for Wales. (Rugby)

James taps into this by visiting Amber Waves Farm, where he borrows their outdoor pizza oven to cook for the farmers using seasonal local produce. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvyorkshire.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Philadelphia
itvyorkshire.uk.description: James visits Philadelphia. `The City of Brotherly Love' is the perfect backdrop for his foodie adventure, with Reading Terminal Market providing all manner of ingredients for both of his cooks. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvyorkshire.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvyorkshire.uk.description: On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

itvyorkshire.uk.title: ITV News
itvyorkshire.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvyorkshire.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvyorkshire.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are racing hero Billy Monger and Gavin and Stacey's Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic. Then, original emergency service vehicles used to help wounded soldiers during the war years make their way onto the show. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvyorkshire.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvyorkshire.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvyorkshire.uk.title: Talking Royals
itvyorkshire.uk.description: A round-up of royal news with expert analysis from ITV News Royal Editor Chris Ship, ITV News royal expert Lizzie Robinson and a host of guests.

itvyorkshire.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itvyorkshire.uk.description: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as four stars - Joey Essex, JB Gill, Caroline Quentin and Harry Akines-Aryeetey - take on each other in the first-ever four-way cooking battle. They'll have to produce stand-out dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two stars who impress the most go straight through to the quarter-finals, and the losing stars will have to impress the world-class chefs and cook again in the cook-off - where one will leave the competition. (Cookery, Entertainment, Reality) - 2026
